name: ascii-tree
description: Styles ASCII trees (heavy ┣━━/┗━━ and light ├──/└── in a ``` block) in Claude's replies on the terminal in a "lineage" palette: every guide in the color of the parent that owns it (brown root, then warm tan → clay → rosewood → stone by depth), every connector one color, green reserved for leaf keys, paths, commands, numbers, quotes and key: value leaves highlighted, children aligned, and wrapping that keeps each row under its own branch with guides unbroken. Explicit line breaks inside a node (a line of only │/┃ guides then text) draw as that node's own continuation lines, aligned at its label and styled like it. On a light theme it draws in a darker light palette that clears 4.5:1 contrast. Absolute and ~/ paths are clickable file:// links (a directory opens in the file manager), including paths with spaces written in quotes or backticks or with escaped spaces, except in Cursor/VS Code terminals, which link paths themselves.
